text: レッドは　あなぬけのヒモを　つかって　＊を　だっしゅつした！

structure.jp: あなぬけのヒモを　つかって

patterns.name: 〜て (how)
patterns.explanation: The て-form here tells how the next action is done, like 'by doing'. あなぬけのヒモを　つかって = 'by using an Escape Rope'.

patterns.name: 〜を (leaving)
patterns.explanation: With verbs of going out, を shows the place you leave, so it reads as 'from'. ＊を　だっしゅつした = 'escaped from ＊'.
